DATED: 17/09/2021  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 673 of 2021 ==========================================================
 RAJKOT MUNICIPAL CORPORATION THROUGH K J SARVAIYA  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR JAYANT P BHATT(169) for the Appellant(s) No. 1 for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 2 MS. JIRGA JHAVERI, APP, (2) for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE UMESH A. TRIVEDI  Date : 17/09/2021

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. N.D. Bhatt, learned advocate for Mr. Jayant P. Bhatt, learned advocate for the appellant submits that this is an appeal filed against an order of acquittal recorded by the Judicial Magistrate First Class (Municipal), Rajkot dated 27.11.2020 for an offence under Food Safety Standards Act,
2006, where Special Leave to Appeal is already filed online.
It appears that the Registry has not taken cognizance of the same, and therefore, this appeal is only notified.

2. He has further submitted that vide communication dated 13.09.2021 addressed to the Registry, it was requested to list Criminal Misc. Application seeking Special Leave to Appeal along with the main Appeal, which was filed in the physical form, hit the deaf ears of the Registry.
3. Hence, Registrar General is directed to look into the matter and report to this Court on or before 24th September, 2021.

(UMESH A. TRIVEDI, J) AMAR SINGH Rajkot Municipal Corporation Through K ... vs State Of Gujarat on 17 September, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150310103/
